result.summary: One typo in the search placeholder and a small visual inconsistency on the promo banner; horizontal clipping of carousel/filter items is treated as intended.

issues.description: Search field placeholder is misspelled as 'Restarants' instead of 'Restaurants'.
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder copy to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.

issues.description: The green promo banner uses a faint overlapping circle graphic that is barely visible and looks like an incomplete or leftover decoration.
issues.suggestion: Increase the contrast/opacity of the decorative circles or replace them with a clearer illustration so the banner looks intentional.
